install:
set -e
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache"
WORK_TMP="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/tmp.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK_TMP"' EXIT
[ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ] || : > "$HOME/.bashrc"
if grep -q 'case \$- in' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then sed -i --follow-symlinks -e '/case \$- in.*esac/d' -e '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
if [ ! -x "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" ] || [ "$(printf '%s\n1.4.0\n' "$("$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" --version)" | sort -V | head -n1)" != "1.4.0" ]; then
  TMPDIR="$WORK_TMP" BUN_INSTALL="$BUN_INSTALL" bash -c 'curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.4.5"'
fi
grep -qF 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
grep -qF '$HOME/.bun/bin' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
REAL_HOME="$(getent passwd "$(id -un)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6 || true)"
if [ -n "$REAL_HOME" ] && [ "$HOME" = "$REAL_HOME" ] && command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/bun/bin /usr/local/bin
  sudo ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bun/bin/bun
  sudo ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bun/bin/bunx
  sudo ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
  sudo ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bunx
fi
TMPDIR="$WORK_TMP" "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" install --frozen-lockfile
